Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps after demo — timing & priority check

Emily — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment: 

- What we covered: low-latency inference for agent workflows, predictable dedicated capacity, and the cost/latency tradeoffs we discussed for your 500k monthly token baseline.
- Key value for Avery Solutions: reduce tail-latency for interactive support agents and cut per-concurrent-session cost by ~35% with batching + prefix caching.

Action items I suggested: 
1) Share a short mutual action plan (attached) — who owns the PoC, success metrics, and timing.
2) Schedule a 30-min tech sync with your infra lead to validate VPC/network approach.
3) Decide whether you want hosted trial capacity or a dedicated reserved pool for the PoC.

Proposed timing: kickoff week of June 28 would keep you on track for a Q3 pilot. If that timing is optimistic or Avery is deprioritizing, tell us and we can either push or pause the effort.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx (attached)

Would you prefer I set up the tech sync with your infra contact, or send the MAP for you to review first?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. The team liked what they saw. We're running a sprint planning session next week and I should have a clearer sense of prioritization after that.

Two quick notes: 
- Can you send the MAP filled with the success metrics example you referenced in the call? That will help our PM evaluate effort vs. value.
- For the tech sync, hold off for now — I'll loop in our infra lead if we greenlight the PoC.

I'll circle back by EOD Friday (June 18) with an internal readout.

—Emily
